selection.method: Risk-rank surviving historical per-reading records by label/model disagreement, indirect attribution, occurrence frames and contact/instrument warnings from recent owner reviews. Retired-only records, the first past-label review windows and new suspect batch 3 windows are excluded. At most six per source, targets at least 12 paragraphs apart. Risk/key selection is deterministic; display order puts ten proposed verdict changes first, then four uncertain cases, then thirty-six identity rechecks whose negative verdicts still look supported. Manually reviewed calls do not manufacture accepted labels.

latestFeedback.scope: Read for manual attribution, instrument and occurrence review; answered passages are excluded. No disagreements without a verdict are inferred as labels.

selection.scope: All past per-reading act and hint labels considered. Gold ranges and confirmed act inventories are context, never implied negative per-hit/hint labels. Models and training labels unchanged.
